user.title: ZHA → Zigbee2MQTT Migration
user.description:
This helper guides you from ZHA to Zigbee2MQTT without breaking dashboards, automations and scripts.

1. **Export** all ZHA devices and entities to a file
2. **Disable ZHA** and set up Zigbee2MQTT
3. Pair your devices in Zigbee2MQTT and **migrate** them one by one – entity ids, names, areas and labels are taken over
4. **Check references** to old device ids

After setup open **Configure** on this integration to start.

export.title: Export ZHA
export.description:
Saves all ZHA devices and entities (names, entity ids, areas, labels, icons, aliases, current states) to `/config/zha2z2m/`. If ZHA is running, the Zigbee network settings are exported too, so Zigbee2MQTT can take over the existing network.

Run the export **before** disabling ZHA. Running it again later replaces the snapshot.

disable_zha.title: Disable ZHA
disable_zha.description:
ZHA and Zigbee2MQTT cannot use the same coordinator at the same time.

**Your coordinator:** `{port}` (ZHA radio `{radio}` → Zigbee2MQTT `adapter: {adapter}`)

After disabling ZHA ({entries} entry/entries):
1. Install the Mosquitto broker and the Zigbee2MQTT add-on
2. Configure Zigbee2MQTT with the port and adapter shown above (optionally with `z2m_configuration_snippet.yaml` from `/config/zha2z2m/`)
3. Start pairing your devices

ZHA's entities stay in place (disabled) until they are migrated.

enable_zha.description: Stop Zigbee2MQTT first! Devices that were already migrated keep their Zigbee2MQTT entities; ZHA will create new entities for them.

migrate_entities.title: Migrate a device – entities
migrate_entities.description:
**{zha_device}** → **{z2m_device}**

For every old ZHA entity (left) choose the Zigbee2MQTT entity that should take over its entity id. Suggestions are preselected. The old ZHA registry entry is removed; its history stays under the same entity id.
